rules: Webhook handler change → test with `stripe trigger` CLI or Stripe test mode; never deploy directly against live keys
Price ID referenced in code must exist in the Stripe dashboard — verify the product exists before deploy
New Stripe env var → add to deploy.yml AND GitHub Secrets in the same commit — deploy.yml rewrites .env on every deploy, silently wiping anything not in both places
Checkout session: verify success_url and cancel_url resolve correctly on the production domain before deploy
Subscription lifecycle change (create/cancel/upgrade/resume) → trace the full webhook chain: checkout.completed → customer.subscription.updated → invoice.paid → DB state
_comment: Starter for any project using Stripe. Rules are universal Stripe failure modes. Edit pipeline_files to match your actual paths.
